facts.business: Zeal Global Services Limited operates in the logistics and allied services ecosystem, engaged in activities associated with the movement and handling of cargo and goods, and also operates in the Passenger Segment as GSSA of Azerbaijan Airlines.
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions include: Asia Shipping International Transport Private Limited (Sale Rs 202.43 lacs), Vidhi Grover (Remuneration Rs 7.20 lacs), Yashasvi Sharma (Remuneration Rs 16.65 lacs), Rahat Continental Private Limited (Sale Rs 36.30 lacs), SGate Tech Solutions Private Limited (Software Expenses Rs 14.18 lacs), ANSP Global Services Private Limited (Investment Rs 450.00 lacs), Zeal Global Services FZ-LLC (Investment Rs 202.69 lacs, Commission Paid Rs 139.23 lacs), SLS Retail Supermart Private Limited (Purchase of Goods Rs 5.00 lacs), Bharti Sharma (Remuneration Rs 30.00 lacs).
